info.name: ONEVO HRMS API
info.description:
ONEVO HRMS Backend API Collection

**Base URL:** http://localhost:5139

**Authentication:**
- Admin routes (/admin/v1/...): Cookie auth via `admin_session` + `admin_csrf` cookies
- Tenant routes (/api/v1/...): Cookie auth via `onevo_session` + `onevo_csrf` cookies
- Enable Postman cookie jar (Cookies > Manage Cookies) for automatic cookie handling
- After each login, copy the csrf cookie value into the matching collection variable:
  - Admin login → copy `admin_csrf` cookie → set `adminCsrfToken`
  - Tenant login → copy `onevo_csrf` cookie → set `tenantCsrfToken`

**CSRF:** All POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on authenticated routes require `X-CSRF-Token` header.
The collection pre-request script auto-extracts these from the Postman cookie jar.
